parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: MEC reported Adjusted EBITDA of $6.5 million in the first quarter of 2026, or 4.5% of net sales, versus $12.2 million, or 9.0% of net sales, in the prior year period.
MEC reported Adjusted EBITDA of $6.5 million in the first quarter of 2026, or 4.5% of net sales, versus $12.2 million, or 9.0% of net sales, in the prior year period.

parsed.notes: The reconciliation table is not in the excerpt, so both figures come from the narrative text. The guidance tables also show prior-period actuals that I left out of the list: Q2 2025 Adjusted EBITDA of $13.7 million and FY 2025 Adjusted EBITDA of $47.1 million. The FY 2025 figure is a full-year total, so add it if you want prior-year totals included; I excluded it because it appears only as a comparison line in the guidance table. The forecasts in those tables are also excluded: Q2 2026 of $10–13 million and FY 2026 of $52–60 million. The release also cites net debt to trailing twelve-month Adjusted EBITDA of 4.4x.
